title: Hinomori Shizuku — Fun With Layout Planning〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Shizuku's Room

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The office in this picture is about the same size as the house. Notice how their meeting space is partitioned off?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, we might need to set certain areas apart.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, in that case!
What if we used some of these racks as dividers?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, that's another idea to keep in mind! They'd act as room dividers while also giving us a place to put cute decorations. Two birds with one stone!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I didn't realize planning the interior of the MORE MORE HOUSE would be so much fun. Now I really can't wait to move in.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Anyway, I should clean and put away the cups we used...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, we didn't put much of a dent into these snacks. I suppose we did spend quite a lot of time talking...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It'd be a shame if they went stale, so maybe I should have some now...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I know!
Shiho's Room

rows.Speaker: Shizuku's Voice
rows.Line: Shii, do you have a minute?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hm? Shizuku...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, were you doing your homework...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, for math.
Anyway, what's up...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Remember those snacks you brought to my room earlier? We still have quite a lot left over.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, I was thinking we could have some together.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Really? Then, I'll take some.
All these complicated equations were starting to make my nerves fray.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, I'm coming in.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: By the way, you were all talking about your new home base, right?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, it's called the MORE MORE HOUSE.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You said you'd found a nice place, but I didn't realize it already had a name.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
It's cute, right?
We spent today discussing how we're going to use each room, as well as their interior designs.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Since it's also going to be our office, we thought about turning one room into a reception area...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And we're thinking about bringing in our own plushies to decorate our streaming room.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Cool. Sounds like this process has been a lot of fun.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It really has! We actually talked so much that we more or less forgot about these snacks.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, won't things get even busier for you once your office and streaming room are all set up?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, but we should be able to figure things out since we have a manager now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, right.
I forgot that you found someone to take on that role.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, her name's Saito, and she's so reliable!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi and Haruka don't have to work nearly as hard now that she's in charge of our schedule.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah, that must've been pretty rough...
Honami also had it pretty bad...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But your band also has a manager now, yes?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. Currently, that person's doing a lot behind the scenes to get us ready for our debut.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Which means we'll both be busy in the future...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: As happy as I am about our new house, I probably won't get to spend as much time at home like this...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're still coming home, right?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, for the most part.
Unless something urgent comes up.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Still, it means having fewer meals and such together, which is very unfortunate...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, remember back when you were at your busiest? We'll figure something out...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shii! Please call me if you're ever feeling lonely! Or just send me a message...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, I will...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We can even say, “Good morning,” and, “Good night,” to each other through text whenever we're not able to see each other.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Now you're asking too much.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Things might not change all that much since it's not like you're moving out or anything.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: True. There's no telling what's going to happen after we get the MORE MORE HOUSE set up...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'll do my best to come home each night so that you don't feel lonely.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Alright, thanks.
